orgJoin.heading: Who can join
orgJoin.help: Which email addresses may join this organization. An invitation is checked against this rule; with auto-join on, anyone signing in with a matching address becomes a member without one.
orgJoin.emailRuleDesc: A regular expression matched against the address. Leave empty to accept any address by invitation.
orgJoin.autoJoinDesc: A matching address becomes a member on first sign-in, with no invitation. Only for a domain your organization controls.
orgJoin.autoJoinRoleDesc: The role everyone admitted by the rule receives.
orgJoin.acceptRisk: I accept that this rule may admit people from outside my organization
